notes: Original official Android bundles are verified by hotlist MD5, byte count and SHA256. Every selected source skill rank and unlocked talent comes from the pinned Global tables, not a guessed kit.

Normal heals release at original Spine OnAttack; native maxAnimScale1 caps animation speed at100ASPD. Breeze S2 and Folinic normal/S2 launch original speed10/5/8 projectiles; presentation uses tracked engine markers and does not claim Unity particle, audio or parabolic mesh fidelity.

Ptilopsis S2 native continuous Heal has empty animKey, waitForAttackEvent1, preDelay0.2 and maxAnimScale-1. The source controller names Skill_Begin whereas original skeleton names Skill_Start; its eventless loop and native FSM dispatcher are not recovered. Runtime uses explicit source Heal preDelay0.2 and cosmetic Skill_Start-to-Skill_Loop alias, without claiming first-heal frame parity or inventing extra0.7 combat lock.

Source spRecover named aura uses maxStack1 and table highest-effect rule. Runtime chooses strongest live eligible producer, preserving weaker fallback and time-SP/noSp restrictions. Corroserum own SP effect is a separate source key and continues to stack.

Warfarin S1 native threshold includes exactly50percent (_maxHpExcludeEqual0); charged replacement heals add selected MaxHP ratio. Blood Sample random selector has excludeOwner0, so self remains a random candidate in addition to guaranteed self SP. Base talents only, no unselected module rank effects.

Warfarin S2 source selects one random nonself ally then always appends self. Buff15sec starts at cast Attack event; native PURE HP-ratio loss skips modifier events, ignores hit SP and may kill. Runtime preserves fired beneficiary buff when the source withdraws. Native buff teardown ordering is not asserted frame-exact.

Whisperain trait uses original inner2-3 range; talent recovery has no far-heal penalty and applies recipient final HPregen scaler exactly once. Native .1sec status polling, one-second derived recovery and immediate first derived trigger are preserved.

Whisperain S1 postFilter30/abnormalFlag20 native dispatcher enum is not executable-recovered. Runtime priority uses supported resistible abnormal statuses plus palsy, then ordinary injured HP priority. This is an explicit selector interpretation, not frame parity.

Folinic environment damage reduction requires explicit original IS_ENVIRONMENT_DAMAGE flag; sourceless, periodic, ordinary damage and HPLOSS are never inferred as environmental. Folinic S2 impact uses original circle radius1.0 and engine body-distance collision; native Unity collider dispatch is not frame-exact.

Warfarin buff and SP selectors have no HEAL purpose. They retain unhealable allies; healFree/noHeal restrict ordinary healing, not these beneficial buff/SP targets. Explicit target-free, hidden, isolated and device restrictions remain.

Warfarin S2 source _canUseInAbnormalState0/_uninterruptibleOnAbilityPredelay0 cancels an unfired cast irreversibly when control is observed before the original Attack OnAttack. Owned per-tick monitoring prevents a brief stun followed by recovery from reviving the pending cast; fired plasma buffs keep their independent duration.
